basic_details.job_title: Juvenile Justice Board Madurai Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Office Assistant, Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Juvenile Justice Board Madurai has announced 3 temporary vacancies for Assistant-cum-Bench Clerk, Junior Assistant-cum-Record Clerk, and Office Assistant posts on a consolidated pay basis. Candidates can apply offline by submitting their filled application form in person or by post to the District Child Protection Unit, District Collectorate Office, Grand Project Office Campus, 3rd Floor, Madurai on or before 30 October 2026 at 5:00 PM. Qualifications vary by post, requiring an 8th standard pass, 10th standard pass, or a recognized degree in various disciplines, with a consolidated pay ranging

age_limit.details: Assistant-cum-Bench Clerk: Must have a recognized degree in Arts, Science, Commerce, Engineering, Medicine, or any other relevant field. Must have studied in a 10.2.3 or 11.1.3 educational system. Must have passed Computer on Office Automation conducted by the Directorate of Technical Education or a diploma course in Computer related studies from a recognized university or institute in India, given priority. Age limit: 42 years. Junior Assistant-cum-Record Clerk: Must have passed 10th standard or an equivalent educational qualification. Age limit: 42 years. Office Assistant: Must have passed 8th standard or an equivalent educational qualification. Age limit: 42 years.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit their completed application forms either in person or through post to the following address on or before 30 October 2026 at 5:00 PM: District Child Protection Unit, District Collectorate Office, Grand Project Office Campus, 3rd Floor, Madurai - 625020

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection for the posts is conducted by a selection committee headed by the District Collector, based on prescribed qualifications, age limit, experience, and other general eligibility conditions. Prior to appointment, selected candidates will undergo a necessary police background verification procedure.

faq.question: Q1. Are these posts permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The notification states that the above posts are entirely temporary.

faq.question: Q2. Can an applicant be removed from service without notice?
faq.answer: Yes, the posts are liable to be removed from service for administrative reasons without any prior notice, and employees have no right to claim a regular post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for all three posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 42 years for all three posts as per the Tamil Nadu Government Servants (Conditions of Service) Act, 2015.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application submission?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by delivering the filled application form in person or via post to the designated Madurai address.
